svg.data-weight-note: 10.005 kg (20.05 lb) per the datasheet. The quick start's own table says 13.48 kg with two PSUs and six fans installed; see the-two-documents-disagree-about-the-chassis.
svg.data-optics-osfp: datasheet: each OSFP800 port takes 1 x 800G or breaks out to 2 x 400 GbE, 4 x 200 GbE or 8 x 100 GbE. Named cables and modules: "800G OSFP SR8 100 m, 800G OSFP 2 x SR4 100 m, 800G OSFP DR8 500 m, 800G OSFP 2 x DR4 500 m", plus DAC/AOC/AEC direct to the cage.

rect.data-members: fan-1 fan-2 fan-3 fan-4 fan-5 fan-6
